title: yieldingly roasted polish duck braised
description: a show-off polish dish featuring green cardamom pods and a rich, velvety sauce.
instructions: Rinse the duck and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the duck with salt, black pepper, and crushed cardamom pods.
In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pot and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the white wine to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom with a wooden spoon.
Add the chicken broth, heavy cream, dried parsley, and thyme to the pot.
Bring the liquid to a simmer and then cover the pot with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue to roast for another 30-40 minutes, or until the duck is cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
